description.description: What the subagent works on, in at most 80 characters; the user sees it in the tasks panel. For connector_develop it also titles the commit and the pull request: connector(slug): description.

prompt.description: The complete brief, at most 32768 characters: the goal, the relevant paths, the constraints and what the report must contain. The subagent sees nothing else of the conversation.

kind.description: investigate answers a question about the code or its dependencies; change makes a bounded change and checks it; connector_select chooses the connectors for the requirements; connector_develop builds or fixes one connector in the connectors library.

slug.description: For connector_develop only: the connector ID, the manifest's metadata.name, such as newsapi; the contribution branch derives from it.

contribution.description: For connector_develop only: new for a new connector, operation for a new operation of an existing connector, fix for a defect fix of an existing connector.

inputs.description: Ignored workspace directories the subagent reads, which its worktree would not hold: only an agent review's placed export, .local/superverse-evolve/<review_id>. Each appears read-only at the same path in the subagent's worktree and never enters its result.
